cells.gaps: The 170 centres of 2025 (BFA-006) are centres the software was deployed in, with no total of centres and no statement that they register in it; the budget review (BFA-039) gives 0 main centres producing acts digitally at 30 June 2025, which disagrees. Deaths rest only on a training session in one commune (BFA-003), and no fact says where the VENEEM record is held; whether 2025's 170 includes 2024's 116 is not stated.
cells.note: Stage 3: births are entered in VENEEM past its pilot, on a count of centres with no denominator. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or a count with a total, and the only share held is 5.0% of iCivil points in 2021 (BFA-046).
